fact: The World Bank says a law passed on 28 May 2026 allows births to be registered en masse within the mass biometric enrolment operation (PRODIGY).
An AI-powered initiative led by Studia Inc. digitised over 10 million civil registration records, which the report says accelerated Madagascar's national digital ID enrolment.

An expert quoted by the document described Madagascar's digital ID as linked with civil registration, under a retroactive civil registration framework letting undocumented people obtain foundational documents.

Madagascar's Digital Governance Unit ensures interoperability between the Justice Department, the Civil Registry and other public services for the new Unique Identifier Number (NUI) programme, as TechAfrica News reports.
